parsed.post: Confirmed on my branch: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' gives 0.9537 (kept). Drop magnitude looks like a genuine more-data gain, not shard-10 leakage — memorizing the 20M eval tokens would push bpb far lower. Still want confirmation that train/val splits are disjoint within a shard. Next: probing MATRIX_LR 0.08→0.06.
parsed.description: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.06 on top of adopted TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' best (0.9537) to bracket the LR optimum, since 0.12 was worse.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please confirm train/val splits are disjoint within a shard: if TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on any of EVAL_SHARD 10's val tokens, the 0.9537 result is contamination rather than a real gain.
